svg.title: Tech stack on three conveyor belts
svg.desc: Three conveyor belts carry technology logos: front-end, back-end and data, machine learning and tooling. Front-end: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, TanStack Query, Zustand, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, Vite, React Router, Recharts, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS. Back-end and data: Node.js, Express, Hono, Prisma, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MySQL, Supabase, MongoDB, Zod, Cloudflare R2, Resend, JWT, Docker, Vercel, Netlify. Machine learning and tooling: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, Streamlit, Hugging Face, Jupyter, Playwright, Vitest, GitHub Actions, Biome, ESLint, Figma, Claude Code, Git.
